facts.text: Jon expresses that dancing is a way for him to express himself and find his happy place.

evidence.quote: Dancing for me is like a way to express myself and find my happy place.
It's a really cool way to express ourselves.

facts.text: Jon mentions that he used to be scared of what people would think about his dancing but now prioritizes his own happiness.

evidence.quote: I used to be scared to death of what people would think, but I learnt that my own happiness is the most important thing.

facts.text: Jon states that seeing his students improve at dancing brings him joy.

evidence.quote: Seeing my students get better at it brings me such joy.

facts.text: Gina recalls that she used to love spending time in the dance studio and that the photo of Jon dancing brings back memories for her.

evidence.quote: I used to love spending time in the studio. That photo looks awesome, brings back lots of memories.
